feeds.title: Physicians Practice
feeds.description: Physicians Practice is America's leading practice management resource for physicians, owners, and administrators. Physicians Practice, a publication of MJH Life Sciences, responds to the growing challenges facing today's medical practices.

feeds.title: 99MGMT Blog
feeds.description: The blog provides practice management, growth resources for physician practices in Texas. Ninety Nine Management is a healthcare management group helping physicians practice medicine independently with increased net revenue.

feeds.title: Open Dental Blog
feeds.description: Open Dental Blog is a dental blog founded by Nathan Sparks in 2008, providing dental professionals with tips and tricks to make the most of their Open Dental practice management software. Discover articles on topics such as scheduling, billing, and patient communication.

feeds.title: Strategic Practice Solutions
feeds.description: Strategic Practice Solutions provides dental practice management, consulting and continuing education for dentists who want to grow their business. The blog is an online resource for dentists and dental professionals interested in specific, step-by-step, practical information that can be used immediately.

feeds.title: Train It Medical Blog
feeds.description: We provide training and consulting services for all practice staff, Principals and Managers focused on improving practice efficiency, saving time and minimizing risk using available technology. Find out more about our training and consulting services to help take your practice to that next level of efficiency.

feeds.title: GP Practice Management Blog
feeds.description: GP Practice Management is the UK's leading provider of support and services to GP Practice Managers. Join over 11,500 members and start improving your practice today. All the latest Practice Managers news, stories and articles keeping you up to date with everything at your GP Practice.

feeds.title: Vetsource Blog
feeds.description: VetSuccess maintains a blog to help you stay informed on how to best reach your practice's goals. Since 2011, VetSuccess has been providing practice performance reports, dashboards, and automated marketing solutions for veterinary practices and industry partners.

feeds.title: Practice Managers Association
feeds.description: The Practice Managers Association (PMA) is a UK-wide membership body that provides insight, training, education and interaction opportunities for those involved in general practice.
